lines.zh: 我飘着走，砸下去才算走。
lines.en: I drift along; the walk only counts when I slam.
The hive points, and I go.
The ground trembles beneath me.

lines.zh: 我这身孢子，走一路撒一路。
lines.en: I scatter spores with every meter.
Heavy things feel safe only after landing.
I do not go around; I smash through.

lines.zh: 四格之内，都是我的落点。
lines.en: Within four blocks, everything is my landing zone.
The shadow over your head is me.
The hive tumor keeps calling me.

lines.zh: 我走得很沉，里面全是孢子。
lines.en: I move heavily; I am full of spores.

lines.zh: 我压过的草，两天长不回来。
lines.en: The grass I flatten will not grow back for days.
I need no road; scent is enough.
One step closer and I drop.

lines.zh: 这身壳，就是为砸而长的。
lines.en: This shell grew for one purpose: to slam.

lines.zh: 我一起身，孢子就往下落。
lines.en: When I lift, spores fall away below me.

lines.zh: 我绕过石柱，石柱还在抖。
lines.en: I drift past the pillar, and it's still shaking.

lines.zh: 我在等蜂巢的下一个念头。
lines.en: I wait for the next thought from the hive.
The spores churn inside my shell.

lines.zh: 不动的时候，我在数落点。
lines.en: Standing still, I count landing spots.
The vanguard observer is watching me.

lines.zh: 这副身体，本来就是造出来的。
lines.en: This body was built, not born.
Mycelium sprouts in the cracks of my shell.
Thirty seconds is enough to infect a whole patch.
I do not think; I receive orders.

lines.zh: 空气里有铁和腐土的味道。
lines.en: The air tastes of iron and rot.
I hover, waiting for a shadow.
It is stuffy inside the shell, but safe.

lines.zh: 被召唤来的东西，不用休息。
lines.en: Summoned things do not need rest.
You are standing exactly four blocks in.

lines.zh: 你仰头的角度，正对上我。
lines.en: The angle you crane up at meets me exactly.

lines.zh: 我看你，像看一块要翻的土。
lines.en: I look at you like soil about to be turned.
My spores are on your boots.

lines.zh: 别躲树后，树也在范围里。
lines.en: Do not hide behind the tree; it is in range too.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸声，我从上面听。
lines.en: I hear your breathing from up here.
The hive says you will make a good seedbed.

lines.zh: 我看你，是因为你还没跑。
lines.en: I watch you because you have not run yet.
There is mycelium on your armor already.
Stand there a moment longer and I land.
The shell cracked; spores everywhere inside.
Chip off a piece and I get lighter.
It hurts, but the hive has not told me to stop.

lines.zh: 你打的这层，是长出来的。
lines.en: What you hit grew on me.
Mycelium will fill that hole.
Seventy points; enough for several slams.
The more you strike, the more spores fly.
Do not come close; the crack sprays.
My shell does not hurt; my task does.
One step back; I need to rise again.
I do not eat; I spread spores.
The hive feeds me; I need nothing from you.
You hold that up like an offering.
Food cannot get through this shell.
All I smell is mycelium.
Take it away; what I want is a landing spot.

lines.zh: 被造出来的东西，不会饿。
lines.en: Things that were built do not get hungry.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，会烂在这里。
lines.en: Whatever you hold will rot here.
Do not lure me; I only know how to drop.
The hive has a bigger appetite than that.
Bump me? I am heavier than I look.
Your shoulder went into a cloud of spores.
Do not press close; the shell has spines.
That bump, and you breathed in plenty.
I hover; you cannot push me.
Back off; I still have a landing to make.
You scraped spores off me.

lines.zh: 撞完，你手上开始痒了吧。
lines.en: After that bump, your hand should start itching.
The hive dislikes being touched.
Push again and I slam right here.

lines.zh: 拥孢体是造的，不是生的。
lines.en: Umarmer are built, not born.

lines.zh: 要新的我，去问蜂巢肿瘤。
lines.en: For a new me, ask the hive tumor.

lines.zh: 拥孢体从不配对，只分芽。
lines.en: Umarmer never pair; we bud.

lines.zh: 菌丝会替我留下下一批。
lines.en: The mycelium will leave the next batch for me.

lines.zh: 两个我，只会抢同一块地。
lines.en: Two of me would only fight over one patch.

lines.zh: 蜂巢里没有夫妻，只有编号。
lines.en: In the hive there are no spouses, only numbers.

lines.zh: 我的壳会烂，孢子会留下。
lines.en: My shell will rot; the spores remain.
No courtship, only summoning.

lines.zh: 我这副样子，不适合成双。
lines.en: This shape of mine does not suit a pair.
Asking that strikes the hive as surplus.

lines.zh: 我捡东西，是为了垫落点。
lines.en: I pick things up to pad my landing.
This heap of dirt will hold the spores down.
A seam is loose; something will plug it.
Holding it makes my slam land heavier.
Everything on the ground belongs to the hive.
Leave it; that is my cushion.
I can lift it; it is just awkward.
A good stone; it makes noise on impact.
Once I take it, I drift back up.
Light things slip out of my grip.
The hive has named you.
Within four blocks, you count as one.
When I drop, do not bother dodging.

lines.zh: 你身上的味道，被标记了。
lines.en: Your scent has been marked.

lines.zh: 前哨观察者把你交给我。
lines.en: The vanguard observer handed you to me.
How many slams will that armor take?

lines.zh: 我看见你站在空地中间。
lines.en: I see you standing in the open middle.
The hive wants you alive; I will try.
Your feet stopped; perfect.

lines.zh: 别跑出四格，跑不出去的。
lines.en: Do not try to leave the four blocks; you cannot.
I am above you, counting to three.

lines.zh: 壳在响，那是要落的声音。
lines.en: The shell rattles; that is the sound of dropping.
The soil under your feet is already loose.
Thirty seconds from now you will still be coughing.
Do not look up; you will want to shut your eyes.

lines.zh: 我落的时候，地会记一下。
lines.en: When I land, the ground will remember it.

lines.zh: 你的同伴离你三格，正好。
lines.en: Your friend is three blocks away; perfect.
Mycelium is already on your soles.
I am measuring the wind; it will push me half a block.
Stand firm; a miss means another drop.
Heavy slam; four blocks go down together.
Eight damage, plus thirty seconds.

lines.zh: 你的肺里开始长东西了。
lines.en: Something is starting to grow in your lungs.
The ground cracked, and so did you.
That flattened every blade of grass.
Do not cough; what comes up is spores.

lines.zh: 我砸的是脚下，不是身上。
lines.en: I strike the ground, not your body.
The radius is wide; you cannot step out.
Shell hits earth; the sound reaches the hive.

lines.zh: 感染第二级，够你走一段。
lines.en: Infection, second stage; enough to carry you a while.

lines.zh: 蜂巢肿瘤开了口，我出来。
lines.en: The hive tumor opens and I come out.

lines.zh: 前哨观察者吹了一声，我到了。
lines.en: The vanguard observer whistled once, and I arrived.

lines.zh: 雏型蜂巢思维想起了我。
lines.en: The proto-hive mind remembered me.
Spores land first; the shell follows.
I come out already hovering.

lines.zh: 这片地的湿度，适合发芽。
lines.en: The damp here suits germination.

lines.zh: 我被造出来，只用了几息。
lines.en: I was built in a few breaths.

lines.zh: 别问我来做什么，看地面。
lines.en: Do not ask my purpose; watch the ground.

lines.zh: 壳还是新的，砸起来更硬。
lines.en: The shell is still new, so it slams harder.
The hive just gained one more fist.
Fire on the shell throws spores farther.
I was falling anyway.
Water only wakes the spores.
Blowing apart counts as spreading, too.

lines.zh: 箭钉进壳缝，孢子漏出来。
lines.en: The arrow bit the seam; spores leak out.
The light makes the mycelium recoil.
I do not eat; I am fed spores.
Lightning struck the shell and it held.
There is no ground to slam in the void.
